Map a subject-level domain to the CTAS subjects frame

Input_Subjects.Rd

CTAS requires one row per subject carrying the grouping variables it uses as reference groups: site, country and region.

Usage

Input_Subjects(
  dfDM,
  strSubjectCol = "USUBJID",
  strSiteCol = "SITEID",
  strCountryCol = "COUNTRY",
  strRegionCol = NULL,
  fnCountry = NULL
)

Arguments

dfDM

data.frame SDTM DM (or any subject-level domain).

strSubjectCol

character Subject identifier column.

strSiteCol

character Site identifier column.

strCountryCol

character Country column. NULL if unavailable, in which case country is derived by fnCountry.

strRegionCol

character Region column. NULL (default) yields NA.

fnCountry

function Optional. Takes the site vector and returns a country vector. Overrides strCountryCol when supplied.

Value

data.frame with one distinct row per subject and columns subject_id, site, country, region.

Details

The country derivation is parameterised rather than hard-coded. PDQRM derives country from characters 11-13 of the site identifier; that is a sponsor convention, not a property of SDTM, so it must be supplied by the caller via fnCountry instead of being inherited.

Examples

Input_Subjects(data.frame(
  USUBJID = c("S1", "S2"),
  SITEID = c("701", "702"),
  COUNTRY = c("USA", "USA")
))
#>   subject_id site country region
#> 1         S1  701     USA   <NA>
#> 2         S2  702     USA   <NA>
